issues.description: User is being redirected to /auth instead of reaching /design/step-3b. The auth page is showing instead of the style blend confirmation screen. The URL shows ?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3b indicating the middleware is requiring authentication before accessing step-3b.
issues.element: Entire page - wrong page being displayed
issues.root_cause: The authentication middleware is blocking access to /design/step-3b and redirecting to /auth. Additionally, there is a repeated 500 Internal Server Error in the console logs, which may indicate the session/auth API endpoint is failing, causing the middleware to treat every request as unauthenticated. The 500 error likely comes from apps/web/app/api/auth/ or a middleware file checking session status.

issues.description: Repeated 500 Internal Server Error on resource load. Console shows 3 instances of 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500'. This is likely the auth session check API failing, causing infinite redirect loops to /auth.
issues.root_cause: An API route under apps/web/app/api/ is returning a 500 error. This could be a missing environment variable (e.g., NEXTAUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL), a broken Supabase/auth client initialization, or a runtime error in the session handler.

issues.description: The step-3b page content (style blend confirmation with percentage bars, Scandinavian/Japandi styles, 'This feels right' button, slider adjustment option) is completely absent — not rendered at all.
issues.root_cause: The page cannot be reached due to auth redirect. Once auth is fixed, step-3b content rendering should be verified separately. However, the 500 error may also indicate step-3b page itself has a server-side error.
